stem: The sinoatrial node, atrioventricular node and the Purkyne tissue have important roles in the cardiac cycle.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the precise location in the heart of the sinoatrial node.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State the part of the cardiac cycle that is directly initiated by the wave of excitation sent out by the sinoatrial node.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Part of the control of the cardiac cycle involves the contraction of the ventricle walls after the walls of the atria have finished contracting.

Outline how this control is achieved.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Name the valves of the heart that **open** soon after the Purkyne tissue has received an impulse from the atrioventricular node.
